name: Beer-Hara no Hiruhara-san
original_name: ビールっ腹の蛭原さん
source:
On graduation day, the protagonist mustered the courage to ask the student council president, Hiruhara, for her second button. Nine years later, when he met her again as newly-employed adult, she'd gained so much weight he thought she was someone else. But inside, she hadn't changed at all...

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/12920]Novelgame[/url]]
